findings.actual: Native16px cluster scale, quiet dark mass, restrained separated rim, source-left brighter face/right shading and same convex/concave corner vocabulary preserve a plausible extension of the actual Plains family. Regional change reads as a warm wood-brown face with muted grey/moss rim rather than an independently painted high-resolution style. No source-level reason to reject before one honest formal-game sample.
findings.limit: Matching topology/alpha alone did not produce this decision; actual displayed pixels were viewed. It does not mean project-wide style/color acceptance or complete forest material identity.

findings.actual: The8x8 field still carries a very faint repeating oblique/diamond-shaped16px plate rhythm, but low2–6RGB face steps no longer produce the conspicuous high-contrast wallpaper columns/diamond plates seen in prior attempts. The field is quiet enough to justify a real sample.
findings.limit: The source is periodic, not natural nonrepeating bark. A darkboard can hide low-contrast repetition; large real near_tree foundation and brighter HUD window must be reviewed before final material admission.

findings.actual: The original vivid bright-green boundary becomes significantly quieter grey/olive, with warm left bevel and a continuous dark right/bottom edge. The4x3 preview retains a clear dark silhouette, but the quieter rim and stronger wood-colour frame may read as a wooden panel/crate or merge with the green forest panorama.
findings.minimum_next: Use fixed candidate bytes in one actual18-window sample with real player, fruit, white thorns, chest/metal gate, thin one-way branches, core/boundary adapter turns and both dark/bright backdrop windows. Preserve failure rather than retune opacity or comparison conditions after a bad sample.

findings.actual: Wood-brown material distinction is visible, but fine bark fissures are deliberately minimal and the native4x3 body remains rectilinear. This does not solve organic root/trunk form, natural supports or whole-region composition.
findings.limit: Do not call it forest finished or use dark texture as evidence of a living-tree structure.

allowed_next_scope: One exact-second-candidate Godot material trial across the real18 selected windows, using existing shared47/core/adapter and unchanged geometry; actual pixels and independent review decide further admission. No mass expansion or more source palette iterations are approved by this source-only review.
